sections.title: Sulle piste d'inverno, nel Parco d'estate
paragraphs: L'Hotel Garnì Maffei si trova a Pinzolo, in Val Rendena, a pochi passi dal centro del paese.

D'inverno si scia sulla Ski Area Pinzolo: la cabinovia è a 30 metri dall'hotel. Con la Pinzolo–Campiglio Express si arriva alle piste di Madonna di Campiglio in circa 16 minuti di impianto. Con un solo skipass avete oltre 150 km di piste nella Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta: la skiarea più grande del Trentino, con piste e snowpark per qualsiasi livello.
D'estate si cammina e si va in bici tra boschi, prati e sentieri, con le Dolomiti di Brenta e il Parco Naturale Adamello Brenta tutto intorno.
In ogni stagione il centro di Pinzolo è a due passi, con le sue tradizioni e i suoi sapori: il modo giusto per chiudere la giornata, tra relax e scoperta.

sections.title: On the slopes in winter, in the Nature Park in summer
paragraphs: The Hotel Garnì Maffei is in Pinzolo, in Val Rendena, a few steps from the centre of the village.

In winter you ski at Ski Area Pinzolo: the gondola is 30 metres from the hotel. The Pinzolo–Campiglio Express lift takes you to the Madonna di Campiglio pistes in about 16 minutes. One ski pass gives you more than 150 km of pistes in the Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta: the largest ski area in Trentino, with pistes and snowparks for every level.
In summer it's walking and cycling through woods, meadows and trails, with the Brenta Dolomites and the Adamello Brenta Nature Park all around.
In every season the centre of Pinzolo is a short walk away, with its traditions and flavours: the right way to end the day, between relaxation and discovery.

sections.title: Zimą na stoku, latem w Parku
paragraphs: Hotel Garnì Maffei znajduje się w Pinzolo, w Val Rendena, kilka kroków od centrum miasteczka.

Zimą jeździ się na nartach w Ski Area Pinzolo: gondola jest 30 metrów od hotelu. Kolejką Pinzolo–Campiglio Express dojedziecie na stoki w Madonna di Campiglio w około 16 minut. Na jednym skipassie macie ponad 150 km tras w Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta: to największy ośrodek narciarski w Trentino, z trasami i snowparkami na każdy poziom.
Latem chodzi się po górach i jeździ na rowerze wśród lasów, łąk i szlaków, a dookoła są Dolomity Brenta i Park Przyrody Adamello Brenta.
O każdej porze roku centrum Pinzolo jest o krok, ze swoimi tradycjami i smakami: dobry sposób na zakończenie dnia, między odpoczynkiem a odkrywaniem.

sections.title: Gdzie zjeść kolację w Pinzolo
paragraphs: U nas dzień zaczyna się od śniadania, a kolację zjecie w Pinzolo, gdzie restauracji i pizzerii nie brakuje. Oto te, które polecamy naszym gościom – przy każdej podajemy odległość od hotelu.
sections.nota: Jest ich znacznie więcej, ale trzeba do nich dojechać samochodem: zapytajcie o radę w recepcji. Między sezonami niektóre lokale zamykają się na kilka tygodni, a w szczycie sezonu warto zarezerwować stolik. Jeśli macie wątpliwości, zapytajcie nas.

sections.title: Zarezerwujcie bezpośrednio u nas

it.meta_description: Hotel Garnì Maffei, a 30 metri dalla cabinovia di Pinzolo. Si esce con gli sci e si arriva a Madonna di Campiglio: oltre 150 km di piste, un solo skipass.
it.lead: Siamo a 5 minuti a piedi dal centro di Pinzolo. D'inverno si prendono gli impianti e si arriva fino alle piste di Madonna di Campiglio. D'estate si fanno escursioni a piedi o in bici.

sections.title: Dalla nostra porta alle piste
paragraphs: La cabinovia Pinzolo–Prà Rodont–Doss del Sabion, per tutti «la funivia», parte a 30 metri dall'hotel, sulla nostra stessa strada. Dalla Ski Area Pinzolo, la Pinzolo–Campiglio Express porta alle piste di Madonna di Campiglio in circa 16 minuti di impianto: si scia nella Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta, oltre 150 km di piste con un solo skipass.
La colazione è dalle 7:30, poi si esce con gli sci e in pochi passi si è alla cabinovia. La sera, sci e scarponi restano nel nostro deposito.

sections.title: Escursioni e bici in Val Rendena
paragraphs: D'estate le Dolomiti di Brenta e il Parco Naturale Adamello Brenta vi affascineranno con i loro colori. Si parte per un'escursione, oppure si prende la mountain bike e si gira la valle. Per chi ama il golf, in zona ci sono due campi da nove buche.
E poi c'è tutto quello che offre il paese: l'atmosfera del centro di Pinzolo, con le sue tradizioni e i suoi sapori autentici, completa un soggiorno che unisce relax e scoperta.

sections.title: Come arrivare a Pinzolo
paragraphs: Ci trovate in Via N. Bolognini 72, 38086 Pinzolo (TN). Per i trasporti vi rimandiamo alle pagine ufficiali di Madonna di Campiglio Dolomiti. Se avete un dubbio sul viaggio, scriveteci: vi rispondiamo noi.

en.meta_description: Hotel Garnì Maffei, 30 metres from the Pinzolo gondola. Head out with your skis and go all the way to Madonna di Campiglio: over 150 km of pistes, one ski pass.
en.lead: We're a 5-minute walk from the centre of Pinzolo. In winter, the lifts take you all the way to the pistes of Madonna di Campiglio. In summer, you can go hiking or cycling.

sections.title: From our front door to the pistes
paragraphs: The Pinzolo–Prà Rodont–Doss del Sabion gondola starts 30 metres from the hotel: its bottom station is on our street. From Ski Area Pinzolo, the Pinzolo–Campiglio Express takes you to the pistes of Madonna di Campiglio in a lift ride of about 16 minutes. It is all part of the Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta: over 150 km of pistes on a single ski pass.
Breakfast is served from 7:30. Then you head out with your skis, and a few steps later you're at the gondola. In the evening, your skis and boots stay in our ski room.

sections.title: Hiking and cycling in Val Rendena
paragraphs: In summer the Brenta Dolomites and the Adamello Brenta Nature Park will charm you with their colours. You can set off on a hike, or take a mountain bike and explore the valley. For golf lovers, there are two nine-hole courses in the area.
And then there's everything the village has to offer: the atmosphere of Pinzolo's centre, with its traditions and authentic flavours, rounds off a stay that combines relaxation and discovery.

sections.title: Getting to Pinzolo
paragraphs: You'll find us at Via N. Bolognini 72, 38086 Pinzolo (TN). For transport details, please see the official Madonna di Campiglio Dolomiti pages. If you have any questions about your journey, write to us and we'll reply personally.

paragraphs: Latem Dolomity Brenta i Park Przyrody Adamello Brenta zachwycą Was swoimi kolorami. Możecie wyruszyć na wędrówkę albo wsiąść na rower górski i pojeździć po dolinie. Miłośnicy golfa mają w okolicy dwa pola na dziewięć dołków.

it.lead: Siamo Luca e Manuela. Alle mail e ai messaggi su WhatsApp rispondiamo noi, di persona.

sections.title: Scriveteci, chiamateci o prenotate in autonomia
paragraphs: Per date, camere o qualunque altra domanda, scriveteci su WhatsApp o per email. Se preferite parlarne a voce, chiamateci al cellulare o al fisso. WhatsApp e cellulare hanno lo stesso numero.

sections.title: Come prenotare
paragraphs: Potete prenotare direttamente con noi, senza intermediari, in tre modi.

items.d: Direttamente da questa pagina troverete le date disponibili, le condizioni e le tariffe.
Scriveteci le date e quanti siete.
Mandateci una mail con le date e le vostre domande, oppure chiamateci.

sections.title: A 30 metri dalla cabinovia
paragraphs: Siamo in Via N. Bolognini 72, 38086 Pinzolo (TN), in Val Rendena. La stazione a valle della cabinovia Pinzolo–Prà Rodont–Doss del Sabion è sulla nostra stessa strada, a 30 metri. Il centro è a 5 minuti a piedi. Potete parcheggiare gratis nei posti liberi davanti all'hotel o a pochi metri; su richiesta c'è un box auto riservato, a pagamento.

faq.q: Fate anche la cena o la mezza pensione?
faq.a: Siamo un hotel garnì: offriamo pernottamento e prima colazione, senza mezza pensione. Per cena, i ristoranti del centro di Pinzolo sono a pochi minuti a piedi.

faq.q: Come funzionano i soggiorni d'inverno?
faq.a: Nelle settimane di alta stagione si soggiorna da sabato a sabato (7 notti) o da sabato a venerdì (6 notti). Nei periodi più tranquilli si possono prenotare anche soggiorni più brevi: le date disponibili le vedete nella prenotazione online.

faq.q: Quali sono gli orari di colazione, arrivo e partenza?
faq.a: La colazione è a buffet, tutti i giorni dalle 7:30 alle 9:30, ed è inclusa nel prezzo. L'arrivo (check-in) è dalle 14:00, la partenza (check-out) entro le 10:00. Su richiesta, in base alla disponibilità, late check-out fino alle 14:00 (25 €) o fino alle 18:00 (50 €).

faq.q: C'è il parcheggio? Avete un box auto?
faq.a: Sì. Si parcheggia gratis nei posti liberi davanti all'hotel o a pochi metri. Su richiesta c'è anche un box auto riservato, a pagamento (altezza 2,40 m).

faq.q: C'è un deposito per gli sci?
faq.a: Sì, abbiamo il deposito per sci e scarponi. La cabinovia di Pinzolo parte a 30 metri dall'hotel.

faq.q: Accettate animali?
faq.a: Cani ammessi su richiesta, in base alla disponibilità delle camere: contattateci prima di prenotare. Non accettiamo gatti.

faq.q: Quanto è la tassa di soggiorno?
faq.a: È di 2 € a persona a notte, per un massimo di 10 notti. Sono esenti i ragazzi sotto i 14 anni. Non è compresa nel prezzo e si paga in hotel, in contanti.

faq.q: Il Wi-Fi è gratuito?
faq.a: Sì, in tutte le camere.

faq.q: Come si riceve la Trentino Guest Card?
faq.a: Se la desiderate, chiedetecela: ve la inviamo prima dell'arrivo.

faq.q: Come si paga? Si può cancellare?
faq.a: Le condizioni di pagamento e di cancellazione dipendono dalla tariffa che scegliete. Le trovate indicate al momento della prenotazione. Per qualsiasi dubbio, scriveteci.

en.meta_title: Contact and FAQs – Hotel Garnì Maffei, Pinzolo
en.meta_description: Message us on WhatsApp or email: Luca and Manuela reply personally. Phone numbers, how to book, finding us in Pinzolo (30 m from the gondola) and FAQs.
en.lead: We're Luca and Manuela. We answer your emails and WhatsApp messages personally.

sections.title: Message us, call us or book on your own
paragraphs: Whether it's about dates, rooms or anything else, send us a WhatsApp message or an email. If you'd rather speak to us, give us a call on our mobile or landline. Our WhatsApp and mobile numbers are the same.

sections.title: How to book
paragraphs: There are three ways to book directly with us, without any middlemen.

items.d: Right from this page you'll find the available dates, the terms and the rates.
Send us your dates and tell us how many of you there are.
Email us your dates and any questions, or call us.

sections.title: 30 metres from the gondola
paragraphs: You'll find us at Via N. Bolognini 72, 38086 Pinzolo (TN), in Val Rendena. The bottom station of the Pinzolo–Prà Rodont–Doss del Sabion gondola is on our street, 30 metres from the hotel. The centre of Pinzolo is a 5-minute walk. You can park for free wherever there's a space, in front of the hotel or a few metres away. A private garage is available on request, for an extra charge.

faq.q: Do you serve dinner or offer half board?
faq.a: We're a B&B (garni hotel), offering room and breakfast only, with no half board. For dinner, the restaurants in the centre of Pinzolo are a few minutes' walk away.

faq.q: How do winter stays work?
faq.a: In high-season weeks, stays run from Saturday to Saturday (7 nights) or from Saturday to Friday (6 nights). In quieter periods you can also book shorter stays: you'll see the available dates when you book online.

faq.q: What are the times for breakfast, check-in and check-out?
faq.a: Breakfast is a buffet, served every day from 7:30 to 9:30, and it's included in the price. Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is by 10:00. On request and subject to availability, late check-out until 14:00 (€25) or until 18:00 (€50).

faq.q: Is there parking? Do you have a private garage?
faq.a: Yes. Parking is free in any available space in front of the hotel or a few metres away. A private garage (height 2.40 m) is also available on request, for a fee.

faq.q: Is there somewhere to store skis?
faq.a: Yes, we have a ski and boot room. The Pinzolo gondola is 30 metres down the road.

faq.q: Do you accept pets?
faq.a: Dogs are welcome on request, depending on room availability: please contact us before booking. We don't accept cats.

faq.q: How much is the tourist tax?
faq.a: It's €2 per person per night, charged for a maximum of 10 nights. Children under 14 are exempt. It isn't included in the price and is payable at the hotel, in cash.

faq.q: Is the Wi-Fi free?
faq.a: Yes, in every room.

faq.q: How do I get the Trentino Guest Card?
faq.a: If you'd like one, just ask us and we'll send it to you before you arrive.

faq.q: How do I pay? Can I cancel?
faq.a: Payment and cancellation terms depend on the rate you choose. You'll see them when you book. If you're unsure about anything, send us a message.

paragraphs: Z pytaniami o terminy, pokoje czy cokolwiek innego piszcie do nas przez WhatsApp lub e-mailem. Jeśli wolicie porozmawiać, zadzwońcie na komórkę albo na telefon stacjonarny. Komórka i WhatsApp mają ten sam numer.

sections.title: Jak zarezerwować
paragraphs: Pobyt możecie zarezerwować bezpośrednio u nas, bez pośredników, na trzy sposoby.

items.d: Bezpośrednio z tej strony znajdziecie wolne terminy, warunki i ceny. System rezerwacji jest w języku angielskim.
Napiszcie nam, kiedy i w ile osób chcecie przyjechać.
Wyślijcie nam e-mail z terminem pobytu i pytaniami albo zadzwońcie.

sections.title: 30 metrów od gondoli
paragraphs: Znajdziecie nas pod adresem Via N. Bolognini 72, 38086 Pinzolo (TN), w Val Rendena. Dolna stacja gondoli Pinzolo–Prà Rodont–Doss del Sabion jest przy tej samej ulicy, 30 metrów od nas. Do centrum dojdziecie pieszo w 5 minut. Samochód możecie bezpłatnie zostawić na wolnym miejscu przed hotelem lub kilka metrów dalej. Na życzenie dostępny jest też osobny garaż, za dodatkową opłatą.

faq.q: Czy oferujecie też kolację albo obiadokolację (HB)?
faq.a: Jesteśmy hotelem garni: oferujemy nocleg ze śniadaniem, bez obiadokolacji. Na kolację macie do wyboru restauracje w centrum Pinzolo, kilka minut pieszo od hotelu.

faq.q: Jak wyglądają pobyty zimą?
faq.a: W tygodniach wysokiego sezonu pobyty trwają od soboty do soboty (7 nocy) lub od soboty do piątku (6 nocy). W spokojniejszych okresach można zarezerwować także krótsze pobyty – wolne terminy sprawdzicie w rezerwacji online.

faq.q: Jakie są godziny śniadania, zameldowania i wymeldowania?
faq.a: Śniadanie w formie bufetu podajemy codziennie od 7:30 do 9:30. Jest wliczone w cenę. Zameldowanie (check-in) od 14:00, wymeldowanie (check-out) do 10:00. Na życzenie, w miarę możliwości, późne wymeldowanie do 14:00 (25 €) lub do 18:00 (50 €).

faq.q: Czy jest parking? Czy macie garaż?
faq.a: Tak. Parkowanie na wolnych miejscach przed hotelem lub kilka metrów dalej jest bezpłatne. Na życzenie możemy też zarezerwować dla Was płatny garaż (wysokość 2,40 m).

faq.q: Czy jest przechowalnia nart?
faq.a: Tak, mamy przechowalnię nart i butów narciarskich. Gondola w Pinzolo jest 30 metrów od hotelu.

faq.q: Czy przyjmujecie zwierzęta?
faq.a: Psy przyjmujemy na życzenie, w zależności od dostępności pokoi: skontaktujcie się z nami przed rezerwacją. Nie przyjmujemy kotów.

faq.q: Ile wynosi podatek turystyczny?
faq.a: Wynosi 2 € za osobę za noc, maksymalnie za 10 nocy. Dzieci poniżej 14 lat są z niego zwolnione. Nie jest wliczony w cenę i płacicie go w hotelu, gotówką.

faq.q: Czy Wi-Fi jest bezpłatne?
faq.a: Tak, we wszystkich pokojach.

faq.q: Jak otrzymać Trentino Guest Card?
faq.a: Jeśli chcecie ją otrzymać, dajcie nam znać – wyślemy ją Wam przed przyjazdem.

faq.q: Jak wygląda płatność? Czy można anulować rezerwację?
faq.a: Warunki płatności i anulowania zależą od wybranej taryfy. Znajdziecie je podczas rezerwacji. W razie wątpliwości napiszcie do nas.

en.meta_description: Privacy policy of Hotel Garnì Maffei in Pinzolo: who handles your data, why, for how long, and what your rights are.
en.lead: On this page we explain, as required by the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, Articles 13 and 14), what personal data we handle when you contact us, book or stay with us. Cookies are covered on the Cookies page.

sections.title: Who the controller is
paragraphs: The data controller is L&M snc di Scaramuzzi Luca e Pederzolli Manuela, the company that runs Hotel Garnì Maffei.
Address: Via N. Bolognini 72, 38086 Pinzolo (TN), Italy. VAT No. 02588730222, REA TN-235607. Email: info@hotelmaffeipinzolo.it. Certified email (PEC): lmsnc2020@pec.cgn.it.
If you have any questions about your data, write to us: Luca and Manuela will reply personally.

sections.title: What data we handle
paragraphs: Contacts and enquiries. Your name, email, phone number and whatever you tell us by email, WhatsApp or phone: dates, number of guests, questions.

Bookings and stays. Dates, rooms, guests, price, payments and guarantees. If you book on our website, we collect them through the Beddy booking system; if you book through a portal such as Booking.com, the portal passes them on to us.

Guest registration. On arrival, Italian law requires us to send the details of each guest's identity document to the police (Article 109 of the Consolidated Law on Public Security), through the State Police's Alloggiati Web service.
Invoices, payments, tourist tax. The details needed for the invoice or receipt and for the provincial tourist tax.

Browsing data. Your IP address and the technical data that servers record when you visit the website and, only if you accept it on the cookie banner, the data collected by the Meta pixel: pages viewed, clicks on the booking buttons, the ad you came from. See the Cookies page for details.

sections.title: Why we handle your data and for how long

righe: To reply to you and prepare a quote
24 months from the last contact, if you don't book
To manage your booking and stay; complaints and disputes
Point (b): the contract; point (f): protecting our rights
10 years from the end of the stay or the cancellation (Art. 2946 of the Italian Civil Code), plus the time needed for any dispute
Once sent, we keep neither the data nor copies of documents; we keep the Alloggiati Web receipt for 5 years, as required by the Ministry of the Interior
Point (c): legal obligation (Art. 2220 of the Italian Civil Code and tax rules)
10 years from the end of the financial year
Security of the website and the booking system
Kept by our providers (GitHub, Beddy, Stripe) under their own rules
To measure visits and bookings opened from our ads on Facebook and Instagram; to show our ads to people who have visited the website
Point (a): consent (together with Art. 122 of the Italian Privacy Code), which you can withdraw at any time
Cookies last 3 months; Meta keeps the data under its own rules

dopo: We don't sell your data and we don't make automated decisions about you. We only use it for advertising if you accept this on the cookie banner, and we don't upload lists of our guests' email addresses or phone numbers to Meta or anyone else.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We only share data with the parties we need in order to work, who handle it either as processors on our behalf (Art. 28 GDPR) or as independent controllers:

items.d: Zucchetti Hospitality (Beddy booking system) and the providers it uses, such as Stripe, and the portals you book through, such as Booking.com.
Banks and card networks: the card you give when booking is only a guarantee, and you pay for your stay at the hotel.
Our email providers, and Meta if you write to us on WhatsApp.
GitHub, which hosts the website.

Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd, only if you accept the pixel on the cookie banner: for collecting and transmitting data through the pixel we are joint controllers with Meta (Art. 26 GDPR); otherwise Meta is an independent controller.
Our tax adviser and, if needed, a lawyer.
The police, statistics offices, the Province for the tourist tax, the Revenue Agency and judicial authorities, when the law requires it.

dopo: We'll send you the up-to-date list of providers and their roles on request.

sections.title: Data outside the European Union
paragraphs: Some providers are based in the United States, such as GitHub, Stripe and Meta. In these cases data is transferred on the basis of the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission (Art. 46 GDPR) and, where applicable, the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (adequacy decision of July 2023). Otherwise, we only transfer data to countries that the Commission considers adequate (Art. 45 GDPR). You can ask us for a copy of the safeguards.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can exercise the rights set out in Articles 15–22 of the GDPR at any time:

items.d: Find out what data we hold and get a copy.
Correct or complete inaccurate data.
Have it deleted, except data the law requires us to keep or that we need to defend a legal claim.
Have its use suspended while a dispute is being checked.
Receive it in a machine-readable format, or have it sent to another controller.
Object to processing based on our legitimate interest.
Withdraw your consent to the pixel whenever you like, from “Cookie settings” at the bottom of every page; it applies from then on.

dopo: Just write to info@hotelmaffeipinzolo.it or to our certified email address lmsnc2020@pec.cgn.it. We'll reply within one month; in complex cases this may be extended by two further months, and we'll tell you within the first month. It's free of charge, unless a request is manifestly unfounded or excessive.

You can also lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali, Piazza Venezia 11, 00187 Rome – www.garanteprivacy.it) or with the supervisory authority of the EU country where you live or work.

sections.title: How we protect your data
paragraphs: Only we and the providers we need can see your data, in systems protected by passwords. The website only works over https, so pages travel encrypted.

sections.title: Updates
paragraphs: This policy may change, for example if our providers or the law change: the version in force is always on this page.
The English and Polish versions are translations: in case of doubt, the Italian text prevails.
Last updated: 2 November 2026 (version 1.0).

Nasz doradca podatkowy i w razie potrzeby prawnik.
Policja, urzędy statystyczne, prowincja (opłata miejscowa), urząd skarbowy i sądy, gdy wymaga tego prawo.

sections.title: Dane poza Unią Europejską

Otrzymać je w formacie nadającym się do odczytu maszynowego lub przekazać je innemu administratorowi.
Sprzeciwić się przetwarzaniu opartemu na naszym prawnie uzasadnionym interesie.

sections.title: Chi è il titolare
paragraphs: L&M snc di Scaramuzzi Luca e Pederzolli Manuela, che gestisce l'Hotel Garnì Maffei. Via N. Bolognini 72, 38086 Pinzolo (TN), P.IVA 02588730222. Email: info@hotelmaffeipinzolo.it. PEC: lmsnc2020@pec.cgn.it.

sections.title: Cosa sono i cookie

sections.title: Cookie tecnici: non serve il consenso
paragraphs: Questi strumenti servono a far funzionare il sito, a ricordare la vostra scelta sui cookie e a rendere sicuri i pagamenti. Per questi la legge non chiede il consenso (art. 122 del Codice privacy).

Ricordare la stagione che avete scelto (inverno o estate) durante la visita
Fino alla chiusura della scheda del browser

Prevenzione delle frodi con le carte. Arriva con la barra di prenotazione di Beddy, anche se nella barra non si paga nulla

La barra si carica alla vostra prima azione sulla pagina (un tocco, un clic, il mouse, la tastiera o lo scorrimento) oppure quando una pagina si apre già scorsa. In quel momento scarica i suoi file e il suo carattere dai server di Beddy e di Stripe, che ricevono l'indirizzo IP del vostro dispositivo.

sections.title: Pixel di Meta: solo se accettate

Ci serve per sapere quante visite arrivano dalle nostre inserzioni su Facebook e Instagram e quante persone poi aprono la prenotazione, e per mostrare le nostre inserzioni a chi ha già visitato il sito.
Se cliccate «Rifiuta», o non scegliete, il pixel non si carica e dal nostro sito a Meta non arriva nulla.

righe: Riconoscere il browser tra una visita e l'altra, per misurare le inserzioni
Ricordare il clic sull'inserzione da cui siete arrivati
Ricordare da quale inserzione siete arrivati, per passarlo al motore di prenotazione
Fino alla chiusura della scheda del browser

Per la raccolta e la trasmissione di questi dati siamo contitolari con Meta (art. 26 GDPR, secondo le condizioni di Meta per gli strumenti business); quello che Meta fa dopo lo decide Meta, come titolare autonomo, secondo la sua informativa: www.facebook.com/privacy/policy. Meta può usare anche i propri cookie sul dominio facebook.com. I dati possono andare negli Stati Uniti: ne parliamo nell'informativa privacy.
Potete cambiare idea quando volete con «Preferenze cookie», in fondo a ogni pagina: se revocate il consenso, il pixel si ferma e cancelliamo i cookie _fbp e _fbc dal nostro dominio.

sections.title: Niente statistiche e nessun altro strumento pubblicitario

sections.title: Come scegliete

La scelta resta sul vostro dispositivo, con la data e la versione di questa pagina, e non ve la richiediamo prima di 6 mesi, salvo che cambi l'elenco degli strumenti. Potete cambiarla quando volete da «Preferenze cookie», in fondo a ogni pagina.

sections.title: Chi ospita il sito
paragraphs: Il sito è ospitato da GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., Stati Uniti). Per sicurezza GitHub registra l'indirizzo IP di chi visita le pagine. Sul trasferimento dei dati negli Stati Uniti vedete l'informativa privacy.

sections.title: Gestire i cookie dal browser
paragraphs: Potete cancellare o bloccare i cookie dalle impostazioni del browser. Senza i cookie tecnici la barra di prenotazione potrebbe non funzionare: potete sempre prenotare scrivendoci.

sections.title: Aggiornamenti

en.meta_description: Cookie policy of Hotel Garnì Maffei in Pinzolo: essential cookies and, only with your consent, the Meta pixel to measure our ads.

sections.title: Who the controller is
paragraphs: L&M snc di Scaramuzzi Luca e Pederzolli Manuela, which runs Hotel Garnì Maffei. Via N. Bolognini 72, 38086 Pinzolo (TN), Italy, VAT No. 02588730222. Email: info@hotelmaffeipinzolo.it. Certified email (PEC): lmsnc2020@pec.cgn.it.
For everything else about how we handle data, see our privacy policy.

sections.title: What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that a website saves on your device and reads again on later visits. The same rules apply to similar tools, such as your browser's local storage.

sections.title: Technical cookies: no consent needed
paragraphs: These tools are needed to make the website work, to remember your cookie choice and to keep payments secure. The law doesn't require consent for these (Article 122 of the Privacy Code).

righe: To remember your choice on the banner (accept or reject), with the date and the version of this page
To remember the season you chose (winter or summer) during your visit
Until you close the browser tab
Card fraud prevention. It comes with the Beddy booking bar, even though nothing is paid in the bar
Card fraud prevention. It comes with the Beddy booking bar, even though nothing is paid in the bar

dopo: Stripe's cookies come with the Beddy booking bar (Zucchetti Hospitality): the bar's code loads Stripe's, the payment provider Beddy uses, and Stripe saves its two anti-fraud cookies. No card is entered in the bar. The bar loads at your first action on the page (a tap, a click, the mouse, the keyboard or scrolling) or when a page opens already scrolled. At that moment it downloads its files and its font from Beddy's and Stripe's servers, which receive your device's IP address.

sections.title: Meta pixel: only if you accept
paragraphs: If you click “Accept” on the banner, the website loads the Meta pixel (Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd). We use it to find out how many visits come from our ads on Facebook and Instagram and how many people then open the booking page, and to show our ads to people who have already visited the website.
If you click “Reject”, or don't choose, the pixel doesn't load and nothing is sent from our website to Meta.

righe: To recognise the browser between visits, to measure our ads
To remember the click on the ad you came from
To remember which ad you came from, so it can be passed on to the booking engine
Until you close the browser tab

dopo: The pixel records the pages you visit, clicks on the booking buttons, your IP address and technical browser data. For collecting and transmitting this data we are joint controllers with Meta (Art. 26 GDPR, under Meta's terms for business tools); what Meta does afterwards is decided by Meta, as an independent controller, under its own policy: www.facebook.com/privacy/policy. Meta may also use its own cookies on the facebook.com domain. Data may be transferred to the United States: see our privacy policy.
You can change your mind at any time with “Cookie settings”, at the bottom of every page: if you withdraw your consent, the pixel stops and we delete the _fbp and _fbc cookies from our domain.

sections.title: No analytics and no other advertising tools
paragraphs: We don't use any analytics tools, such as Google Analytics, or any advertising tools other than the Meta pixel.

The fonts on our pages are hosted on our own website: we don't use Google Fonts. Google Maps, Instagram, WhatsApp and the restaurants' websites only open if you tap the link, and from then on those websites' rules apply.

sections.title: How you choose
paragraphs: On your first visit, the banner asks you whether to accept or reject the Meta pixel, with two identical buttons. If you don't choose, only the essential cookies are used and you can carry on browsing.

Your choice is kept on your device, with the date and the version of this page, and we won't ask again for 6 months, unless the list of tools changes. You can change it at any time from “Cookie settings”, at the bottom of every page.

sections.title: Who hosts the website
paragraphs: The website is hosted by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., United States). For security, GitHub records the IP address of visitors. For data transfers to the United States, see our privacy policy.

sections.title: Managing cookies in your browser
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Without technical cookies the booking bar may not work: you can always book by writing to us.

sections.title: Updates
paragraphs: This page changes if the website's tools change; if the list changes significantly, the banner will ask for your choice again. The English and Polish versions are translations: in case of doubt, the Italian text prevails.

sections.title: Piksel Meta: tylko za Waszą zgodą
paragraphs: Jeśli w banerze klikniecie „Akceptuję”, strona załaduje piksel Meta (Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd). W zakresie zbierania i przekazywania tych danych jesteśmy współadministratorami z Meta (art. 26 RODO, zgodnie z warunkami Meta dla narzędzi biznesowych); o dalszym przetwarzaniu decyduje Meta jako niezależny administrator, zgodnie ze swoją polityką: www.facebook.com/privacy/policy. Meta może używać także własnych plików cookie w domenie facebook.com. Dane mogą być przekazywane do Stanów Zjednoczonych: piszemy o tym w polityce prywatności.
Możecie zmienić zdanie w każdej chwili przez „Ustawienia plików cookie” na dole każdej strony: po wycofaniu zgody piksel przestaje działać, a my usuwamy pliki cookie _fbp i _fbc z naszej domeny.

sections.title: Bez statystyk i bez innych narzędzi reklamowych

Czcionki przechowujemy razem z resztą strony: nie korzystamy z Google Fonts. Mapy Google, Instagram, WhatsApp i strony restauracji otwierają się tylko wtedy, gdy klikniecie link; od tej chwili obowiązują zasady tych serwisów.

sections.title: Jak dokonujecie wyboru
paragraphs: Przy pierwszej wizycie baner pyta, czy akceptujecie piksel Meta, czy go odrzucacie – oba przyciski wyglądają tak samo. Jeśli nie wybierzecie, działają tylko techniczne pliki cookie i możecie dalej przeglądać stronę.

sections.title: Zarządzanie plikami cookie w przeglądarce
paragraphs: Możecie usunąć lub zablokować pliki cookie w ustawieniach przeglądarki. Bez technicznych plików cookie pasek rezerwacji może nie działać: zawsze możecie zarezerwować pobyt, pisząc do nas.

it.meta_description: Dicembre a Pinzolo prima delle feste: piste appena aperte, a 30 metri dalla cabinovia, colazione con le torte fatte in casa. Prezzo migliore sul nostro sito.
it.h1: Dicembre a Pinzolo, prima delle feste
it.lead: Piste appena aperte, paese tranquillo e la colazione con le torte fatte in casa, a 30 metri dalla cabinovia. Per il ponte dell'Immacolata e per le settimane di dicembre, il prezzo migliore lo trovate qui, prenotando direttamente con noi.

items.d: Gli impianti di Pinzolo aprono il 3 dicembre (apertura prevista). La cabinovia parte a 30 metri dall'hotel, sulla nostra stessa strada.
Fino al 19 dicembre lo skipass della Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta ha la tariffa di bassa stagione.
Prima delle feste Pinzolo è più calmo, e i ristoranti del centro sono a pochi minuti a piedi.

items.t: Colazione con le torte fatte in casa
items.d: Ogni mattina dalle 7:30 alle 9:30, a buffet, inclusa nel prezzo.
Deposito per sci e scarponi in hotel. Parcheggio libero e gratuito davanti all'hotel o a pochi metri.
Su richiesta, in base alla disponibilità: fino alle 14:00 (25 €) o fino alle 18:00 (50 €).

sections.title: Prenotate direttamente da noi
paragraphs: Con il codice DICEMBRE5 avete il 5% in meno sui soggiorni dopo il ponte dell'Immacolata, dal 9 al 24 dicembre, prenotati qui sul sito: scrivetelo nel campo Coupon quando cercate le date.

Sul nostro sito trovate il prezzo migliore e le date libere, senza intermediari. Se cercate altre date o una camera per la famiglia, scriveteci su WhatsApp al +39 366 480 5227 o a info@hotelmaffeipinzolo.it: vi rispondiamo noi, Luca e Manuela.
